description: Runtime packaging tiers for Atomic Rain. The default full tier preserves current behavior. Lean is currently a link-safe content-light package: it keeps the same runtime file graph while the heaviest shared references are compressed in place.

full.description: Complete runtime package. Excludes only repository-maintenance material.

lean.description: Link-safe lightweight package for common black-box testing. File-level pruning is intentionally disabled until the builder can rewrite or close over all markdown and plain-text runtime references.
